indicator.name: S&P 500 vs 200-day Moving Average
indicator.description: The percentage distance between the S&P 500 and its 200-trading-day simple moving average.
indicator.methodology: Percentage deviation of the S&P 500 close from its 200-trading-day simple moving average. The component is trend-oriented: higher deviation maps to a higher score through a historical percentile. A zero line marks the moving average.
indicator.limitations: This is primarily a trend indicator, not a valuation measure. A market above its 200-day average can still be expensive, and a market below it can still be cheap.
